quotes.text:
win64-aarch64/debug:
    description: "AArch64 Win64 Debug"
    index:
        product: thunderbird
        job-name: win64-aarch64-debug
    attributes:
        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
    treeherder:
        platform: windows2012-aarch64/debug
        symbol: B
        tier: 1
    worker:
        max-run-time: 7200
        env:
            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: aarch64
            RUST_MIN_STACK: "16777216"
    mozconfig:
        variant: debug
        platform: win64-aarch64
    run:
        actions: [build]
        options: [append-env-variables-from-configs]
        script: mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py
        config:
            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
            - builds/taskcluster_sub_win64/debug.py
    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
    use-sccache: true
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-7zz
            - linux64-cbindgen
            - linux64-clang
            - linux64-dump_syms
            - linux64-nasm
            - linux64-node
            - linux64-rust-cross
            - linux64-rust-size
            - linux64-sccache
            - linux64-upx
            - linux64-winchecksec
            - linux64-wine
            - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
            - winappsdk-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc

win64-aarch64/opt:
    description: "AArch64 Win64 Opt"
    index:
        product: thunderbird
        job-name: win64-aarch64-opt
    attributes:
        enable-build-signing: true
        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
    treeherder:
        platform: windows2012-aarch64/opt
        symbol: B
        tier: 1
    worker:
        max-run-time: 7200
        env:
            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: aarch64
            RUST_MIN_STACK: "16777216"
    mozconfig:
        platform: win64-aarch64
    run:
        actions: [build]
        options: [append-env-variables-from-configs]
        script: mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py
        config:
            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
        extra-config:
            stage_platform: win64-aarch64
    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
    use-sccache: true
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - linux64-7zz
            - linux64-cbindgen
            - linux64-clang
            - linux64-dump_syms
            - linux64-nasm
            - linux64-node
            - linux64-rust-cross
            - linux64-rust-size
            - linux64-sccache
            - linux64-upx
            - linux64-winchecksec
            - linux64-wine
            - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
            - terser
            - winappsdk-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc

text: 667 adds debug and opt Windows Arm64 jobs built with Linux-side Rust/Clang/Wine tools and architecture-specific mozconfig values. The opt job enables signing and full crash symbols; debug enables full crash symbols. Current jobs use a mozconfig object and fetch winappsdk-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc, rather than the historical extra-config mozconfig_platform field and UPX fetch entry. A Windows target label does not mean the worker executes natively on Windows. No graph generation, toolchain fetch or Arm64 artifact test was run.
title: Describe cross-compilation by target, worker tools and artifacts separately
